title: Schola Xanthi
description: The Schola Xanthi was likely the seat of the scribae, praecones, and librarii of the curule aediles. A dedicatory inscription names Bebryx Aug. lib. Drusianus and A. Fabius Xanthus as those responsible for erecting the structure during the principate of Tiberius. There was a subsequent renovation in the third century. The Schola Xanthi is thought to correspond with a structure excavated in 1539 on the clivus Capitolinus between the Arch of Septimius Severus and the Arch of Tiberius. The archaeological remains do not survive.
